text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's first G1 race is finally

happening tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's in my bag. I even remembered
to pack a
spare pair of shoes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I've made sure they're properly

attached.
...Trainer, please try to relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to help her relax, but she ends
up
comforting me instead.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting a call. Please excuse me for a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hello? Father? Yes, I'm doing well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right. ...Hehehe! Father was
checking to see
if I forgot anything, just
like you.
choice_data_list: ご両親から応援の電話？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me is always more
nervous than
I am before a race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I told him I'm definitely going to win, but
he still
just told me to be careful not to
get injured.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You might be right. My parents have
never once
told me to win. They've
always been so gentle
with me.
choice_data_list: それも本心だと思うよ

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And that's precisely why I want to win
tomorrow's
race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I aspire to become an illustrious runner
and to
bring honor to my parents by
being the first to
realize our family's
dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Despite being so busy, Mother and
Father have
both always dedicated
themselves to advancing
the
Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to reward them for all their hard
work! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The Satono family's first G1
victory!
choice_data_list: 最高のご褒美を届けないとな！
最高のご褒美を届けないとね！
